elements.text: codebot wants approval to open a pull request on acme/widget.

text.text:
*What*:
• Phase 1 — Clone the repository and read it
    • _read:_ read files and history in the checkout
    • _read:_ read the repository on GitHub
    • reaches GitHub repository (acme/widget)
• Phase 2 — Make the change and commit locally
    • _write:_ write files in the checkout and commit
    • reaches GitHub repository (acme/widget)
• Phase 3 — Push the branch and open a pull request
    • _write:_ push the branch to GitHub
    • *external:* open a pull request on GitHub (leaves this session)
    • reaches GitHub repository (acme/widget)
• Approving covers every phase above.
• *Why (the agent's words)*: Fixing the flaky test in the payments suite and opening a PR for review.
• *When*: Now, for as long as this session runs.
• *Who can approve*: An owner of this session.
